mission_03: Robust scaling uses the median and interquartile range (IQR) instead of mean and standard deviation, making it resistant to outliers. When your data contains extreme values, min-max and z-score scaling can be heavily distorted. Robust scaling centers the data using the median (50th percentile) and scales using the IQR (difference between 75th and 25th percentiles). This mission demonstrates why robust scaling is essential for datasets with outliers and how it preserves the relative positions of the majority of data points.
